# Vuneli

> Sustainability consultant for small and medium businesses in Cyprus, working in English and Greek (el-CY). Vuneli reads utility bills, bank payments and supplier records, tracks the EU and Cyprus rules that apply to each business (VSME, CBAM, EUDR, CSRD), and prepares reports, answers and funding matches. A person approves every action.

What works today: Verde, an AI consultant that cites its sources and drafts documents for approval; EAC electricity and Nicosia water bill reading by upload or email; bills matched to bank payments; deadlines matched to each business from a fixed rulebook, with EU law amendments flagged for human review; CBAM calculations with official EU default values; supplier screening against the EU consolidated sanctions list; funding calls shown only when the business is likely eligible; print-grade PDFs whose fingerprint anyone can check at /verify. Bank and accounting connections are being tested. Pricing is in EUR.

- [Vision and roadmap (English)](/en/vision): What is live, what is being tested and what comes next.
- [Όραμα και πλάνο (Ελληνικά)](/el/vision): Τι λειτουργεί, τι δοκιμάζεται και τι ακολουθεί.
